node.statement: By validated node 1.4.1, p(t)=t^2-(1-d)t+q=(t-r_-)(t-r_+) has two real roots r_-<r_+, with r_-<1/8 and r_+>=1-(K_sq+4C_prod)e. By node 1.2, p(a_1)>=0, and a_1 is nonnegative by its definition as an infimum of norm ratios. Since the leading coefficient of p is positive, p(a_1)>=0 implies a_1<=r_- or a_1>=r_+. The hypothesis a_1>=1/4 rules out a_1<=r_- because r_-<1/8<1/4. Hence a_1>=r_+>=1-(K_sq+4C_prod)e=1-C_diag e.
